description:
Your persistent memory across all AI tools. CALL THIS BEFORE STARTING ANY TASK to check for past caveats (pain records), decisions, and learnings — prevents repeating mistakes across sessions.

Typical usage: recall({ query: "keywords" }) for search, recall({ path: "file.ts" }) for file history, recall() for overview.

WHEN TO CALL:
• Before starting any new task or touching a file
• When the user mentions "before" / "前に" / "last time" / "remember when"
• When an error occurs — check if you've seen it before
• When making a decision — check for prior decisions on the same topic

THREE MODES (auto-detected):
• Search (default): provide query → returns memories ranked by relevance + heat
• File history: provide path → returns complete edit history with user-intent context
• Session brief: omit all params → what needs attention (🔴/🟡), where you are on the Map, open loops (proposals / distill queue / friction), top entities. CALL THIS FIRST in a new session.
• Locate: where: "<topic>" → your position on the Current Truth Map + blast radius (what else moves if you touch this). where: true → auto-locate from recent edits
• Dream: dream: true → North Star + orphaned proposals to triage + distill_queue + friction (the full triage session; the brief carries only the counts)
• Entity list: overview: true (the old no-arg behaviour)

Works across Claude, GPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini — one local SQLite file, nothing leaves your machine.

distill.description: With dream: how many raw memories to return for rewriting (default 8, max 25). The queue is value-ordered; rule-verdicted items never appear.

dream.description: Return the full triage set: North Star, orphaned proposals (each with candidate_id), distill_queue, friction. Resolve proposals with resolve_drift({ candidate_id, action }); rewrite distill items with remember({ memory_id, content }).

explain.description: Include ranking internals (composite, heat, band, momentum, match_reasons, score_breakdown). Off by default so more memories fit the token budget.

kind.description: For overview mode: filter by entity kind.

max_intents.description: For file mode: max user-intent snippets. Default 10.

min_memories.description: For overview mode: minimum memory count. Default 1.

overview.description: Return the entity list instead of the session brief when no query is given.

path.description: File path or substring. When set, returns file edit history with per-edit user-intent context instead of memory search.

project.description: With where: the Map project slug, when several maps are imported.

query.description: What you want to remember. Use keywords, entity names, or FTS5 expressions. Omit for entity overview.

scope_to_roots.description: For file mode: filter to client-provided roots.

thread_id.description: Filter by thread ID for decision chains.

where.description: Locate on the Current Truth Map. A topic string, or true to auto-locate from the files you edited recently. Returns your node, journey stage, blast radius, and the decision behind it.

name: recall
